name: Cain
summary: The firstborn son of Adam and Eve, a farmer who killed his brother Abel. The LORD sent him away to wander, but set a mark on him so that no one would kill him.

key_moments.title: Two Offerings
key_moments.description: Cain brought the LORD an offering of his crops, and Abel brought the firstborn of his flock. The LORD accepted Abel's offering but not Cain's, and Cain grew very angry, though the LORD warned him that sin was waiting at his door.

key_moments.title: The First Murder
key_moments.description: Cain talked with Abel, then attacked and killed him in the field. When the LORD asked where Abel was, Cain said he did not know and asked if he was meant to watch over his brother.

key_moments.title: Marked and Sent Away
key_moments.description: Cain said his punishment was more than he could bear. The LORD set a mark on him so no one would kill him, and Cain went to live in the land of Nod, east of Eden.

key_moments.title: Builds a City
key_moments.description: Cain had a son named Enoch, and he built a city and named it after his son.
